authority_invariant: Observability and readiness systems record, evaluate, wake and route only within existing authority; they never manufacture provider, security, legal, economic, deployment, rights, credential or governance authority.

systems.purpose: Canonical typed error taxonomy, safe error envelopes, retryability classification, normalization, and dead-letter evidence across PENTA runtimes.
systems.human_surface: Runtime error evidence, incident diagnostics, and operator-safe failure readback
systems.authority_boundary: May classify and serialize failures but cannot authorize retries, provider writes, rollback, or remediation beyond already-granted policy.

five_stage.discover: Capture the concrete exception, operation, trace, and bounded context.
five_stage.govern: Apply error code, severity, safety, retryability, and redaction policy.
five_stage.execute: Normalize the failure into a canonical PentaError envelope.
five_stage.verify: Validate schema, redaction, trace linkage, retry semantics, and safe/public messaging.
five_stage.preserve: Retain error evidence through registered logging, dead-letter, status, and archive paths.

systems.purpose: Structured JSON-line logging with severity controls, trace correlation, contextual child loggers, mandatory secret redaction, and normalized exception evidence.
systems.human_surface: Machine-readable operational logs and operator diagnostics
systems.authority_boundary: Emits evidence only; log emission does not create execution, notification, retention, or external-provider authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve service/member identity, trace context, severity, event, and bounded fields.
five_stage.govern: Apply redaction, minimum severity, safe error, and environment policy.
five_stage.execute: Emit deterministic structured JSON evidence to the configured local sink.
five_stage.verify: Parse output and prove required schema, trace, redaction, and level behavior.
five_stage.preserve: Hand structured evidence to separately authorized storage, status, audit, or alert routes.

systems.purpose: Trace, correlation, span, parent-span, and scoped context propagation across bounded PENTA operations.
systems.human_surface: Cross-runtime execution lineage and correlation evidence
systems.authority_boundary: Correlation identifies lineage only and never expands the caller's capability or authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve or create trace and correlation context.
five_stage.govern: Preserve lineage boundaries and avoid embedding secret material in identifiers.
five_stage.execute: Bind scoped context and create child spans where required.
five_stage.verify: Confirm parent/child trace continuity and deterministic correlation propagation.
five_stage.preserve: Attach trace evidence to logs, errors, metrics, receipts, and dead-letter payloads.

systems.purpose: Thread-safe local counters, gauges, duration observations, and deterministic metric snapshots for PENTA runtime evidence.
systems.authority_boundary: Collects local metric evidence only; external export or alerting requires a separately certified provider route.

five_stage.discover: Resolve metric name, type, value, operation, and runtime context.
five_stage.govern: Validate metric names and bounded numeric semantics.
five_stage.execute: Record counters, gauges, observations, and timers locally.
five_stage.verify: Produce deterministic snapshots and validate count/sum/min/max/average semantics.
five_stage.preserve: Expose snapshots to separately authorized telemetry, assurance, and status lanes.

systems.purpose: Public-safe heartbeat and liveness primitive that projects PentaRoute plus sanitized PentaOD/PentaHeartbeat readiness without executing provider actions.
systems.human_surface: Low-risk system liveness and readiness readback
systems.authority_boundary: May report liveness and readiness only; it cannot wake a held or retired component, certify an operation, expose secret material, or authorize a provider mutation.

five_stage.discover: Read current route and readiness state.
five_stage.govern: Apply public-safe projection and secret-redaction boundaries.
five_stage.verify: Confirm current PentaOD/PentaRoute state is reachable and bounded.
five_stage.preserve: Feed aggregate status into PentaHeartbeat and PentaStatus.

systems.purpose: Whole-system heartbeat and readiness aggregation across PentaOD, PentaBeata, PentaMesh, PentaFabric, PentaStatus, CHLOM mesh health and the canonical ThriveBase heartbeat.
systems.authority_boundary: May reconcile and report heartbeat/readiness state; it cannot create certification, credentials, provider authority, money movement, rights or D3 authority.

five_stage.discover: Aggregate current PENTA, mesh and ThriveBase liveness state.
five_stage.govern: Classify freshness and readiness without converting a HOLD into authority.
five_stage.execute: Record the bounded heartbeat receipt and status projection.
five_stage.verify: Check heartbeat freshness, mesh state and PentaOD component counts.
five_stage.preserve: Append heartbeat receipts and update the canonical status registry.

systems.purpose: On-demand readiness, wake, idle and dispatch coordination for CrownThrive capabilities that already possess the required authority, credentials and certification.
systems.human_surface: HOT/WARM/SLEEP/HOLD/DEGRADED/RETIRED component state, wake controls and dispatch-readiness receipts
systems.authority_boundary: Readiness is not authority. PentaOD may wake or prepare a component only when its existing authority, credential, certification and heartbeat requirements already pass. D3, blocked, held and retired capabilities fail closed.

five_stage.discover: Classify registered services and exact operations by current readiness evidence.
five_stage.govern: Enforce credential, certification, risk, retirement and fail-closed boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Wake HOT or certified on-demand components and prepare bounded dispatch without accepting arbitrary provider payloads.
five_stage.verify: Require fresh heartbeat and, for write lanes, exact verified_write certification with idempotency, rollback and read-after-write evidence.
five_stage.preserve: Append wake/dispatch receipts, idle state, heartbeat state and component lineage.
